articles.author: Said MOUNAIM
articles.description:
LinkLoop


LinkLoop is a clean, minimal Linktree-style web app built with Next.js 15, Prisma, BetterAuth, and ShadCN/UI. Easily share multiple links through a personalized profile. Users can sign up, manage profiles, and customize their link collections with emoji and titles.
Check out a live demo profile:

https://link-loop-share.vercel.app/profile/saidmounaim
Run the following command to clone the repo:
git clone https://github.com/saidMounaim/link-loop.git

Install all dependencies by running:
npm install

.env file


Create a .env file in the root directory with the following environment variables:
DATABASE_URL=""
BETTER_AUTH_BASE_URL=""
BETTER_AUTH_SECRET=""

Make sure your .env file is configured correctly to connect to your database and BetterAuth.
Start the development server with:
npm run dev

🔐 User sign-up and sign-in with BetterAuth
👤 Create profile with avatar, bio, and username
🔗 Add, edit, reorder, and delete links with emoji and title
📊 Track link click counts
💅 Clean and responsive UI using ShadCN/UI and Tailwind CSS
Next.js 15
Tailwind CSS
TypeScript
ShadCN/UI
Prisma ORM
BetterAuth
All kinds of contributions are welcome 🙌

Feel free to fork the repo, create a feature branch, and submit a pull request.
articles.title: Minimal Linktree-style web app built with Next.js 15, Prisma, BetterAuth, and ShadCN/UI.

articles.description:
As we moved deeper into the development of EventHub, weeks 10 and 11 reminded us of something critical:
During these weeks, we worked closely as a team to refine both the technical side of the platform and the user experience. The focus was clear:
We dedicated significant time to responsive design to ensure that EventHub feels just as smooth on a mobile screen as it does on a laptop. Knowing that most students rely on their phones, this step was essential.
But the real highlight?
We’re building EventHub as developers, but we’re also growing as teammates and professionals.
More growth ahead. More challenges to face. And we’re ready. 🚀
These weeks were all about testing, debugging, and improving. We spent hours going through the platform, identifying bugs, refining user flows, and making sure that every feature works smoothly and securely. We also worked on strengthening authentication and improving the security of user data — because building a platform means taking responsibility for its users.
One of the biggest lessons during this phase?
It hasn’t always been easy — late nights, frustrating bugs, tests that fail over and over — but that’s how we grow. And honestly, seeing the platform evolve and improve week by week makes it all worth it.
Proud of how far we’ve come. Grateful for the effort of the whole team. And excited about what’s coming next. 🚀


  
  
  WebDevelopment #Testing #Debugging #Security #GrowthJourney #EventHub
